features: Adds an Archived Events library accessible directly from the main Admin Dashboard and sidebar
Archived Events lists event date, status, scoring-round count, registration count, archive time and archive administrator
Open lets admins access the preserved event and ticket record without restoring it to active operations
Restore Event removes only the archive marker and returns the event to active operational workflows without recreating or modifying historical data
Adds Open Archived Events and View Archived Events links beside the existing dashboard Archive Event workflow
Keeps archive and restore protected by authenticated admin access, CSRF validation and confirmation
Preserves registrations, competitors, scoring data, results and points throughout archive and restore
No Staging or Production deployment performed
